name: Old Lighthouse
description: A crumbling lighthouse on the bay headland. No longer lit.

name: Collapsed Bridge
description: An old stone bridge, half-collapsed into the murky river below.

name: Ironpeak Summit
description: The highest point in the eastern frontier. Commanding view of three regions.

name: Precursor Monolith
description: A massive carved stone of unknown origin. Inscribed with precursor glyphs.

name: Sunken Waystation
description: An old trading waystation, now half-submerged in swamp water.

name: Stonehill Shrine
description: A small cairn shrine erected by early settlers. Offerings still visible.

name: Verdant Grove
description: A perfectly circular grove of ancient trees. Unnaturally quiet inside.
